property_summary: For every fuzzed bytes4 id, C reports support for the IAccessControl interface id (computed as the XOR of its five role-function selectors obtained from c's public functions) regardless of the queried id; the mutant drops IAccessControl from supportsInterface, so it returns false for that id and violates the rule.
change_summary: Replace the checked interface id with IERC165 so IAccessControl's id is no longer reported as supported.
